<reason>A won by locking the clash on lumpy content and adverse selection: easy monthly pause/split/reconfigure converts the middle household into a peak-chaser, so peaks, no troughs, and no higher sticker cannot travel together. B’s cable-resentment and pause-as-relationship frames were sharp, but never explained how year-round discounts or next year’s library survive a one-toggle default once trough months vanish. A also better distinguished already-easy browser cancel from the motion’s Lego-kit default.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Rebuttal 2 A1/A2: a discount without commitment is a coupon, so a four-month household never buys twelve beside one-toggle pause/split; next season is funded by ordinary remaining months, not an “addressable” free option.</best_rebuttal>
